tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Midnight at night, white by day.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, modals, inputs and the nav bar. By day it matches `bg`, so give it a `border` or `shadow-card`.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Grouped sections and neutral tags, one step up from `bg` (Slate at night, Surface by day).

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed backgrounds on rows, ghost buttons and icon buttons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card edges and dividers. Decorative; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outlines of inputs, selects, unchecked checkboxes and the off switch track. 3.3:1 or better on `bg`, `surface` and `panel` in both themes (an addition: the source's `border` is too faint for controls).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text (Ink at night, Midnight by day) on `bg`, `surface`, `panel`, `hover` and every `-soft` tint, 12:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, placeholders and inactive nav items on `bg`, `surface` and `panel` (4.6:1 or better). Not on `hover` or `-soft` tints by day; use `text` there.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Fills and borders of disabled controls. Disabled states are exempt from contrast minimums; never use it for live text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring (the source's Focus). 4:1 or better on `bg`, `surface` and `panel` in both themes. Kept violet so focus stays visible on a sunset button.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text, checks and switch knobs on a solid hue fill (primary button, solid pills, checked box). Midnight in both themes: 8.8:1 on `sunset`, 7:1 or better on every other hue except `purple`, where it is 4.47:1, a hair under AA. Keep solid purple pills to one short word, or use `purple-soft` with `purple-text` where legibility matters.

tokens.name: sunset
tokens.usage: The primary. Fills for the one primary button per view, the active nav bar, checked boxes and switches that are on, and the Balance and Finance pills. Too light for text or small marks by day; use `sunset-text`.

tokens.name: sunset-text
tokens.usage: Sunset as text or a small mark: the active nav item, links, Finance tags. 4.5:1 or better on `bg`, `surface`, `hover` and `sunset-soft` in both themes.

tokens.name: sunset-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for Finance tags and warm highlights.

tokens.name: glow-1
tokens.usage: First stop of the golden-hour gradient on a wordmark or one hero word (`sq-glow-text`). Large text only: every stop passes 3:1 on `bg` in both themes.

tokens.name: glow-2
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the golden-hour gradient.

tokens.name: glow-3
tokens.usage: Last stop of the golden-hour gradient.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: The Work category and the Curiosity pill. Fills only; text goes in `purple-text`.

tokens.name: purple-text
tokens.usage: Purple as text or a mark: Work tags, the info alert. 6:1 or better on `bg`, `surface` and `purple-soft`.

tokens.name: purple-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Work tags and info alerts.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: The Travel category. Fills only; text goes in `teal-text`.

tokens.name: teal-text
tokens.usage: Teal as text or a mark: Travel tags and card eyebrows. 4.8:1 or better on `bg`, `surface` and `teal-soft`.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Travel tags.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: The Play category (gaming, hobbies) and the Adventure pill. An addition: it appears in the source's pills and tags but not its token list.

tokens.name: sky-text
tokens.usage: Sky as text or a mark: Play and Gaming tags. 5.4:1 or better on `bg`, `surface` and `sky-soft`.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Play tags.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: The Ideas category and highlights; the favorite heart. Fills only; text goes in `pink-text`.

tokens.name: pink-text
tokens.usage: Pink as text or a mark: Ideas tags, the filled heart. 5.1:1 or better on `bg`, `surface` and `pink-soft`.

tokens.name: pink-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Ideas tags.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Success and the Health category; the Creativity pill. Fills only; text goes in `sage-text`.

tokens.name: sage-text
tokens.usage: Sage as text or a mark: success alerts, Health tags. 4.8:1 or better on `bg`, `surface` and `sage-soft`.

tokens.name: sage-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success alerts and Health tags.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Fills only; text goes in `coral-text`.

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: Coral as text or a mark: the danger alert, field errors. 5.3:1 or better on `bg`, `surface` and `coral-soft`.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger alerts.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Sora Bold and ExtraBold, for big ideas, section headers and hero moments.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The wordmark and one hero line per page.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles and hero statements. Title case is fine here.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Inter: Bold for headings, Regular for everything you read in the product.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles in apps and dashboards.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A system to help you stay organized, curious and intentional.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Set in uppercase. Section labels and the hero tagline only, never body copy or buttons.

groups.name: Hand
groups.note: Caveat, a marker hand, for the one handwritten note a page is allowed. An addition that recreates the source's lettering.

styles.name: hand
styles.usage: A sign-off on a hero, an empty state or a card back. Once per page, never for labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside tight controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons and inputs; gap between tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and tag side padding; gap inside alerts.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and alert padding; gap between stacked controls.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; preview padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

radius.note: Things you press are pills; things you read are soft rectangles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes and small icon wells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, alerts, color swatches.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the nav bar, card media.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, pills, switches, the nav indicator.

shadow.note: Soft by day, deep at night, and one warm glow for the primary.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the nav bar.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The primary button on hover: a little golden hour. Nothing else glows.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px `bg` gap, then 2px of solid `focus`. Never remove it.
